methodology.decisions: Each decision below was explicitly authored for its exact exam/question ID after reading content. Repeated concepts receive consistent treatment, but IDs, rationales and question excerpts remain distinct.
methodology.primary_preservation: Keep the existing primary chapter whenever defensible; change it only for a direct content-based correction explained in that row. Existing chapter memberships remain represented when a new primary is justified.
methodology.multiple_assignment: Add chapters only when their concepts are actually evaluated: signatures versus encryption, service versus mechanism, certificate authentication versus public-key management, comparison of symmetric/asymmetric properties. An incidental occurrence of a cipher name, modular arithmetic or the word key does not cause extra assignments.
methodology.number_theory: The supplied tree has no standalone detailed number-theory/group/Euclid/knapsack foundation topics. Retain the existing Chapter 3 proposal for such questions, flag outside_or_unverified, and assign no invented 03.* official topic ID. This is preservation of an unverified proposal, not confirmation that the source places all mathematics in Chapter 3.
methodology.toc_only: Named public-key systems, hashing/signatures and key-management questions can match the existing chapter titles 3/4/5. Those chapter-level judgments never certify nonexistent detailed topics.
methodology.legacy_topics: Existing inferred codes such as 03.01,03.02,04.01,04.03,05.01 are recorded under existing_assignment but are not emitted as official topic_ids because the supplied tree does not define them. This audit does not authorize deleting those legacy fields.
methodology.topic_specificity: Use only the 54 topic IDs actually printed in the tree. Known plaintext/ciphertext key recovery for Hill fits 02.01.13 more specifically than 02.01.07; constructing the AES S-box fits 02.03.10 more specifically than arithmetic alone.
methodology.autokey: The fully read tree explicitly defines 02.01.08 as initial seed followed by plaintext. Keep that classification for khóa chạy questions even when printed choices appear to fit repeating Vigenere; answer defects do not drive classification.
methodology.source_defects: Wrong/missing numerical choices, literal f(n), the DES/SubBytes misnomer and unnamed fraction symbols do not by themselves alter the knowledge concept. No mathematical or answer-key correction is applied here.
